tools.name: formsonfire_list_forms
tools.description: List the forms (screens) in the organization with id, name, version and status. Use a form id with formsonfire_get_form or formsonfire_search_entries. GET /screen/form/search.

tools.name: formsonfire_get_form
tools.description: One form's definition: name, version, status and its fields (names and types, which are the names to use for prefilled answers). Give the form's id (GUID) or its external id. GET /screen/form.

tools.name: formsonfire_search_entries
tools.description: Search submitted form entries (the completed forms your team sent in): who filled them, when, where (GPS) and every answer. Filter by form id or external id, version and a date range (by received time, or complete time via order_by). Returns the page of Entries with TotalRows. GET /formentry/search.

tools.name: formsonfire_search_tasks
tools.description: Search tasks (jobs assigned to field workers, each with one or more activities such as filling out a form): status, assignee, due time, activities and history. Filter by assignee, status, name, task template and date range. Returns the page of Tasks with TotalRows. GET /task/search.

tools.name: formsonfire_get_task
tools.description: One task by its id (GUID), with activities and history. GET /task.

tools.name: formsonfire_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task for a field worker with one form to fill out, optionally with prefilled answers. By default it remains a draft; send_immediate=true sends it and notifies the worker. Identify the worker by email, user id or external id (list_users). The form is identified by its external id (for

tools.name: formsonfire_list_users
tools.description: List the organization's users (field workers and admins): name, email, status, groups, website role and last activity. Passwords and keys are never returned. GET /user/search.

tools.name: formsonfire_get_user
tools.description: One user by id (GUID): name, status, groups, folders, role and registered devices. GET /user.

tools.name: formsonfire_list_groups
tools.description: List user groups with their id, name and member user ids. Filter by name or external id. Returns UserGroups with TotalRows. GET /usergroup/search.

tools.name: formsonfire_list_data_sources
tools.description: List the data sources (lookup tables that feed dropdowns and prefill in forms, such as customers, sites or products): id, external id, name and row count. Use formsonfire_get_data_source for the rows. GET /datasource/search.

tools.name: formsonfire_get_data_source
tools.description: One data source by id (GUID) or external id: its column headers, TotalRows and (with return_rows) a page of rows. Rows are only returned when return_rows is true; page through them with page_no. GET /datasource.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "formsonfire_list_users" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: formsonfire_list_users, formsonfire_list_data_sources · Private data: formsonfire_list_users · Public sink: formsonfire_create_task, formsonfire_list_users.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: formsonfire_list_users, formsonfire_list_data_sources · Private data: formsonfire_list_users · Public sink: formsonfire_create_task, formsonfire_list_users

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
